name: MenteeBot V3

source.quote: Israel's Mentee Robotics has unveiled an updated version of its versatile Menteebot humanoid. MenteeBot V3.0 is a fully integrated humanoid robot with full-stack AI and proprietary hardware.

review.reason: The official MenteeBot product page states 40 DoF for MenteeBot V3, matching the recorded value and claim scope.

source.quote: With its hot-swappable battery system, the robot can operate continuously for more than three hours without any disruptions.
Mentee has signed an agreement to be acquired by Mobileye, with the transaction expected to close in the first quarter

order_type.note: MenteeBot is not offered for sale; no price, cart, waitlist, or preorder mechanism was found on menteebot.com. Mentee Robotics is being acquired by Mobileye (deal announced Jan 2026) and describes 2026 as a proof-of-concept stage with select enterprise customers ahead of planned 2027 production, not a public buying process.

timeline.detail: Mentee Robotics unveiled MenteeBot V3.0, a fully integrated humanoid with proprietary hardware and hot-swappable batteries for continuous operation.

source.quote: Israel's Mentee Robotics has unveiled an updated version of its versatile Menteebot humanoid.

timeline.detail: Mentee published an 18-minute continuous (uncut) shot of two V3 MenteeBots working together in a warehouse, moving boxes between piles and flow racks without human intervention.

source.quote: In the 18-minute continuous shot, two V3 MenteeBots transfer a total of 32 boxes from eight different piles into four flow racks.
In the 18-minute continuous shot, two V3 MenteeBots transfer a total of 32 boxes from eight different piles into four flow racks.

review.reason: The text source was reviewed, but no video segment was watched; the existing capability status and autonomy classification for the exact recorded robot variant were not fully verified.

capabilities.note: Same 2025-11-24 uncut warehouse demo already used for the delivery timeline; Mentee's own release describes it as autonomous dual-robot operation without human intervention.

promises.claim: First on-site proof-of-concept deployments with customers
promises.quote: first on-site proof-of-concept deployments with customers expected in 2026

promises.claim: Series production and commercialization of MenteeBot
promises.quote: series production and commercialization are targeted for 2028

notes: Battery runtime is reported inconsistently across press coverage (Interesting Engineering: 'more than three hours'; other outlets: 'around 4 hours') and is not stated on Mentee's own /bot/ page, so battery_runtime_min is omitted rather than picking one figure.

No official price has been published by Mentee Robotics; a $35,000 figure circulates on aggregator/marketplace sites but was not traced back to a manufacturer statement, so price_history is left empty.

In 2026 press reported Mobileye (whose CEO Amnon Shashua also founded Mentee Robotics) in talks to acquire Mentee Robotics; this is a corporate/ownership development, not a delivery or spec fact, and was not verified further for this record.

locomotion left out (2026-09-21): searched the manufacturer's own product/press page and its main launch coverage (The Robot Report / IEEE Spectrum / named outlet where applicable) for a literal quote naming the propulsion ("bipedal", "legs", "walks", "wheeled base", etc.); none of the pages fetched in this pass contained a checkable sentence naming it specifically for MenteeBot -- most pages describe height/DOF/speed without ever stating the locomotion type in words. Left out rather than inferred from photos or category. Revisit with a source that states it directly.
